selection_rationale: Fallback to the official v0.1 commit after the GitHub commits-until API request returned HTTP 403 rate limit exceeded. This 2020 snapshot retains the Triton-C frontend and custom Triton-IR, but is not asserted to be the exact source version used for the 2019 paper experiments.
checkout_method: Independent Git repository, depth-1 fetch of the exact SHA, detached HEAD; no submodules or full history.
disk_check_before_download: 66 GiB available on the workspace filesystem; historical source estimated below 100 MiB; no disk hard quota claimed.
mapping_limits: No independent prefetch pass identified in this snapshot; do not equate an unrelated pass with paper section 5.1.1.
No psi-named node identified in the project's own old IR sources; phi is not assumed equivalent to paper notation.
The historical custom-operation tutorial contains a punctuation error in its Python wrapper; only the C kernel is used for the reading exercise.
